data.one_liner: A simple to use mocking package for Dio intended to be used in tests.
data.what_it_does: It provides various types and methods to declaratively mock request-response communication for the Dio HTTP client. It allows simulating server behavior and network requests in test environments.
use_when: You are writing tests for a Dart or Flutter project using the Dio package for networking.
You need to declaratively mock HTTP requests and responses.
avoid_when: You are not using Dio for networking (e.g., you use the default http package).
You require complex production interceptors that aren't related to testing.
strengths: Simple to use for mocking Dio requests in tests
Includes features like response delays and exact body checks
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Dio package
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev_dependency in pubspec.yaml and import in test files.

alternatives.name: mockito
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer general-purpose mocking of classes instead of a specialized HTTP/Dio adapter.

alternatives.name: mocktail
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a mocktail-style mocking library without explicit code generation.
